gateResults.summary: GitHub API returned the expected draft release, target, tag, and five immutable asset identities.
Independent download, safe extraction, candidate identity, provenance, ABI, pthread mode, exact eight-file inventory, sizes, and hashes matched.
DOCX-to-PDF, reuse, negative, recovery, and ABI checks passed against downloaded bytes; the bespoke script did not explicitly evidence converter cleanup.

The retry-free Chromium gate failed at tests/office-conversion/office-browser.playwright.ts:501:58: expected cancellation lastProgress.phase 'converting', received 'finalizing'. The outer command was then terminated after 604.1 seconds with exit code 124.
Fresh-browser sample 1 failed and timed out at the command boundary; samples 2-5 were not run, as required by fail-closed/no-retry acceptance.

Default branch main remains at df3f73c789e6d2abf71cbcd75186118d2bbc795a without either guard. The feature-branch structural check also incorrectly allows malformed tags including vfoo.bar, v1.x, v1..2, and v1.2.
GitHub Actions shows Build WASM run 31211473147 as the newest run for workflow 325462492; no later native build exists.
verify.mjs help presents --spec and --expected-candidate-id as optional and omits --report-out, while parseOptions requires all three.
Release 367637128 remains draft with published_at null; downloaded and PDFHow-local candidate metadata both retain releaseQualified false.

rejectionReasons: The mandatory retry-free PDFHow Chromium candidate gate failed and the command boundary timed out.
The first cold-start sample failed; five consecutive passing samples do not exist.
Release-trigger guards are not present on the default branch.
The proposed release-tag guard is not a strict v<semver> guard and allows malformed release tags.
requiredRemediation: Preserve this failed sample and diagnose the cancellation progress-state mismatch and post-failure command hang before a distinct acceptance attempt.
Implement and test strict semantic-version release gating, then merge both workflow guards to the default branch before publication.
Make verifier optional arguments match its documented CLI contract and include --report-out in help.
Retain the draft and releaseQualified false; do not finalize, publish, replace payload assets, or trigger a native build.
